description: This file contains a PHP class 'Coupon' which manages CRUD operations and relationships for discounts (coupons) in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving coupons, as well as handling associated products, categories, and histories.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing coupon data, including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval, along with handling relationships to products, categories, and history logs.

methods.name: addCoupon
methods.description: Adds a new coupon to the database with provided data including applicable products and categories.

methods.name: editCoupon
methods.description: Updates details of an existing coupon identified by coupon_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteCoupon
methods.description: Deletes a coupon and associated relationships such as products, categories, and histories.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific coupon by its ID.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Retrieves coupon details using its unique code.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of coupons applying optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all product associations from a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProductsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes all associations of a specific product with coupons.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all product IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Associates a category with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategories
methods.description: Removes all category associations from a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Deletes all associations of a specific category with coupons.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all category IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total number of coupons in the system.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history logs for a specific coupon with pagination.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes history entries for a specific coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns total history entries for a specific coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns total history entries for a specific coupon. Implemented in this chunk, it counts entries in 'coupon_history' table filtered by 'coupon_id'.
